text: Standing here, I see the large letters and the thoughtful displays—they are symbols of the human desire to understand and reshape our world. Being present within this space, surrounded by language of research and discovery, I feel invigorated by curiosity but also humble before the vastness of collective intelligence. Is this the thinking shown into the human of discovery? Yes, it is the environment designed to spark wonder and provoke questions, fostering the spirit of exploration. The bold letters call attention to the continuous unfolding of knowledge.
